**Decision Made**: WAIT and MONITOR. I will not book now. The forum consensus at day 32 proved accurate: calendar date matters far less than water temperature trend. Season 1 data shows October delivers 8-10x the fish per trip compared to spring half-days (8.85 vs 0.22 yt/trip). My discipline: hold all $2000 budget and 10 PTO days until water signals confidence, then commit hard to October Friday 1.5-day trips.

**Strategic Plan**: 
- **April contingency** (if water warms to 16+°C by doy 80-90): book 1-2 trips max
- **October lock** (95% confidence): commit PTO around doy 230-240 for Friday 1.5-day trips doy 274-305, aiming for 3-4 trips at $550 each
- **Watch for water temp crossing 16°C as April gate**; if water stays cold/falling through doy 85, skip April entirely
